fusions.name: Across the Table
fusions.desc: Costs 4% of your maximum health. A musk-fed flea leaps from your coat to an enemy up to 8 tiles away and deals 7 damage, rising to 2.2 times that at maximum range, and leaves it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Lands Reeking
fusions.desc: Leaps up to 7 tiles to your target and lands in a burst of musk and fleas that deals 13 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and leaves each [Hindered] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Over Their Heads
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 20% for 10 seconds and leaps you 3 tiles from where you stood.

fusions.name: Feeds Where It Itches
fusions.desc: Each time you inflict a condition, your attacks heal you for 15% of the damage they deal for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
